sources.quote:
A supplier may deliver a part only if the approved supplier list contains an approval for that
supplier, that part, the receiving site and the customer.

A supplier audit qualifies the supplier as a company. It does not approve the supplier for any
part.

findings.why: The ASL has controlled HS-410 records for PLT-BEI and CUST-AUR (SUP-G and SUP-E), but none for Meccanica Chisone (SUP-C). The re-audit approval of 2026-11-06 only qualifies the company. It gives no approval for this part.

sources.quote:
The supplier shall obtain written approval from Aurelia (PPAP resubmission) before shipping parts
after any of: a change of source
Aurelia shall be notified of every planned change at least 90 days before implementation.

findings.why: HS-410 belongs to PRG-X, a program of Aurelia. Revision 4 of the Aurelia manual replaces revision 3. It requires written PPAP approval for a change of source and 90 days' notice. Nothing in force covers this change. DEV-121 only covers coating thickness at SUP-E.

sources.quote:
A change of source requires a material certificate (EN 10204 type 3.1) from the new supplier for
the drawing material. Missing certificates are an open question for the supplier quality engineer.

findings.why: The drawing material of HS-410 is MAT-DC04. No 3.1 certificate for DC04 from Meccanica Chisone (SUP-C) is on file. REG-CAPABILITIES also lists no capability for it, and SUP-C is an aluminium supplier. The SQE (Elena Gallo) needs to answer this.
